name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v3346: v3343 said the diff is correct and no defects are present, and was filed verdict=findings with ONE finding whose text was the WHOLE ANSWER. The cause is the parser, not the declaration: _findings_from starts a block only on a numbered or bulleted line, so an answer with no such line comes back as one block containing everything. _declares_none is NOT widened - the phrasing that slipped past it is the comma-tail #76 measured and refused. MY FIRST DESIGN WAS REFUTED BY MEASUREMENT: firing on structure-absence alone would have reclassified 172 of 637 findings-rows including a real defect. With the phrase test the radius is 8 of 637 and they are the same defect being corrected; the one wrong flip lands on cannot-tell rather than clean, so nothing is cleared. The phrase test is downgrade-only and a law pins structurally that it can never reach a clean return.
